zh-cn.显示颜色: 2 bit 四色：白、青、红、黑（无灰阶）
zh-cn.类型: 全反射式 TFT LCD（无背光，依靠环境光显示）
zh-cn.通信接口: 4 线 SPI（只写，FPC 无 MISO/SDO；示例 20MHz）

en.Type: Fully reflective TFT LCD (no backlight, uses ambient light)
en.Interface: 4-wire SPI (write-only, no MISO/SDO on FPC; example runs at 20MHz)
en.Operating Voltage: 3.3V (power and logic; connect both supply pins)
en.Pin Count: 21Pin FPC (incl. TE frame sync and reserved touch pins)
en.Pin Definition: GND(1/4/7/14/20/21), NC(2/3), VCC 3.3V(5/6), RESET(8, active low), SCLK(9), TE(10), MOSI/SDI(11), D/C(12, silkscreen RS), CS(13, active low), touch(15-19, not populated on this module)
